{{Youmay|the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] [[Malbo]] and [[Tyri]]|[[Last Call (Ginivex-class)|''Last Call'']], the [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|''Ginivex''-class starfighter]]}}
The '''''Last Call''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] [[Malbo]] and [[Tyri]]. When the Rangers sent a group of agents to recover some data from a [[Joruba Consortium]] compound on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], they agreed to pick the agents up in the ''Last Call'', once the mission had been completed.
